description: This file contains a function 'xml_hardware' that collects hardware information from system components via a system info object and converts it into an XML formatted string. It also includes an 'html_hardware' function for generating HTML output of hardware details using XPath. The file appears to be part of a hardware information module in a larger PHP-based system monitoring or reporting project.

methods.name: xml_hardware
methods.description: Generates an XML string summarizing hardware components (CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, USB) obtained via the system info object. The output includes details like CPU count, model, speed, cache, bogomips, as well as device lists for PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices.

methods.name: html_hardware
methods.description: Produces HTML output displaying hardware information by parsing data from an XPath object and formatting it into an HTML table. It includes details on CPU specs and device lists for PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices.
